description: Sabaragamuwa  Provincial Council   -  By-Laws of Godakawela Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content establishes a new by-law regulating dangerous and unpleasant businesses within the Godakawela Pradeshiya Sabha area. It creates a comprehensive regulatory framework with licensing requirements, operational standards, and compliance rules. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the creation of subsidiary legislation under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, establishing binding legal requirements for business operations.
